verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh wə·’el- ’a·hă·rōn lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . . and Aaron . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés e a Arão:

verses.original: אָדָ֗ם כִּֽי־ יִהְיֶ֤ה בְעוֹר־ בְּשָׂרוֹ֙ שְׂאֵ֤ת אֽוֹ־ סַפַּ֙חַת֙ א֣וֹ בַהֶ֔רֶת וְהָיָ֥ה בְעוֹר־ בְּשָׂר֖וֹ לְנֶ֣גַע צָרָ֑עַת וְהוּבָא֙ אֶל־ אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֔ן א֛וֹ אֶל־ אַחַ֥ד מִבָּנָ֖יו הַכֹּהֲנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḏām kî- yih·yeh ḇə·‘ō·wr- bə·śā·rōw śə·’êṯ ’ōw- sap·pa·ḥaṯ ’ōw ḇa·he·reṯ wə·hā·yāh ḇə·‘ō·wr- bə·śā·rōw lə·ne·ḡa‘ ṣā·rā·‘aṯ wə·hū·ḇā ’el- ’a·hă·rōn hak·kō·hên ’ōw ’el- ’a·ḥaḏ mib·bā·nāw hak·kō·hă·nîm
verses.literal: When someone has a swelling or rash or bright spot on his skin . . . that may be an infectious skin . . . disease he must be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons who is a priest
verses.literalPt: Quando um homem tiver na pele da sua carne uma inchação ou pústula, ou mancha lustrosa, e esta se tornar na pele da sua carne como praga da lepra, será levado a Arão, sacerdote, ou a um dos seus filhos, sacerdotes.

verses.original: וְרָאָ֣ה הַכֹּהֵ֣ן אֶת־ הַנֶּ֣גַע בְּעֽוֹר־ הַ֠בָּשָׂר וְשֵׂעָ֨ר בַּנֶּ֜גַע הָפַ֣ךְ׀ לָבָ֗ן וּמַרְאֵ֤ה הַנֶּ֙גַע֙ עָמֹק֙ מֵע֣וֹר בְּשָׂר֔וֹ נֶ֥גַע צָרַ֖עַת ה֑וּא וְרָאָ֥הוּ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן וְטִמֵּ֥א אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·’āh hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- han·ne·ḡa‘ bə·‘ō·wr- hab·bā·śār wə·śê·‘ār ban·ne·ḡa‘ hā·p̄aḵ lā·ḇān ū·mar·’êh han·ne·ḡa‘ ‘ā·mōq mê·‘ō·wr bə·śā·rōw ne·ḡa‘ ṣā·ra·‘aṯ hū wə·rā·’ā·hū hak·kō·hên wə·ṭim·mê ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: The priest is to examine the infection on his skin . . . and if the hair in the infection has turned white and the sore appears to be deeper than the skin . . . . . . it is a skin disease After the priest examines him he must pronounce him unclean
verses.literalPt: O sacerdote examinará a praga na pele da carne. Se o pelo na praga se tiver tornado branco, e a praga parecer mais funda que a pele da carne, é praga de lepra; o sacerdote o examinará e o declarará imundo.

verses.original: וְאִם־ בַּהֶרֶת֩ לְבָנָ֨ה הִ֜וא בְּע֣וֹר בְּשָׂר֗וֹ וְעָמֹק֙ אֵין־ מַרְאֶ֣הָ מִן־ הָע֔וֹר וּשְׂעָרָ֖ה לֹא־ הָפַ֣ךְ לָבָ֑ן וְהִסְגִּ֧יר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת־ הַנֶּ֖גַע שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ba·he·reṯ lə·ḇā·nāh hî bə·‘ō·wr bə·śā·rōw wə·‘ā·mōq ’ên- mar·’e·hā min- hā·‘ō·wr ū·śə·‘ā·rāh lō- hā·p̄aḵ lā·ḇān wə·his·gîr hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- han·ne·ḡa‘ šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm
verses.literal: If, however the spot on his skin . . . is white . . . and does not appear to be deeper than the skin and the hair in it has not turned white the priest shall isolate the infected person for seven days
verses.literalPt: Se a mancha lustrosa for branca na pele da carne e não parecer mais funda que a pele, e o pelo não se tiver tornado branco, o sacerdote encerrará por sete dias aquele que tem a praga.

verses.original: וְרָאָ֣הוּ הַכֹּהֵן֮ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי֒ וְהִנֵּ֤ה הַנֶּ֙גַע֙ עָמַ֣ד בְּעֵינָ֔יו לֹֽא־ פָשָׂ֥ה הַנֶּ֖גַע בָּע֑וֹר וְהִסְגִּיר֧וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֛ן שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים שֵׁנִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·’ā·hū hak·kō·hên bay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î wə·hin·nêh han·ne·ḡa‘ ‘ā·maḏ bə·‘ê·nāw lō- p̄ā·śāh han·ne·ḡa‘ bā·‘ō·wr wə·his·gî·rōw hak·kō·hên šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm šê·nîṯ
verses.literal: On the seventh day the priest is to reexamine him and if he sees that the infection is unchanged and has not spread . . . on the skin the priest must isolate him for another seven days
verses.literalPt: Ao sétimo dia, o sacerdote o examinará; se na sua opinião a praga tiver parado e não se tiver estendido, encerrá-lo-á mais sete dias.

verses.original: וְרָאָה֩ הַכֹּהֵ֨ן אֹת֜וֹ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי֮ שֵׁנִית֒ וְהִנֵּה֙ כֵּהָ֣ה הַנֶּ֔גַע וְלֹא־ פָשָׂ֥ה הַנֶּ֖גַע בָּע֑וֹר וְטִהֲר֤וֹ הַכֹּהֵן֙ מִסְפַּ֣חַת הִ֔יא וְכִבֶּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖יו וְטָהֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·’āh hak·kō·hên ’ō·ṯōw bay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î šê·nîṯ wə·hin·nêh kê·hāh han·ne·ḡa‘ wə·lō- p̄ā·śāh han·ne·ḡa‘ bā·‘ō·wr wə·ṭi·hă·rōw hak·kō·hên mis·pa·ḥaṯ hî wə·ḵib·bes bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·ṭā·hêr
verses.literal: The priest will examine him again on the seventh day and if the sore has faded and has not spread . . . on the skin the priest shall pronounce him clean it is a rash The person must wash his clothes and be clean
verses.literalPt: Ao sétimo dia, o sacerdote tornará a examiná-lo. Se a praga for de uma cor escura e não se tiver estendido na pele, declará-lo-á limpo: é uma pústula. O homem lavará os seus vestidos, e será limpo.

verses.original: וְאִם־ פָּשֹׂ֨ה תִפְשֶׂ֤ה הַמִּסְפַּ֙חַת֙ בָּע֔וֹר אַחֲרֵ֧י הֵרָאֹת֛וֹ אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן לְטָהֳרָת֑וֹ וְנִרְאָ֥ה שֵׁנִ֖ית אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- pā·śōh ṯip̄·śeh ham·mis·pa·ḥaṯ bā·‘ō·wr ’a·ḥă·rê hê·rā·’ō·ṯōw ’el- hak·kō·hên lə·ṭā·ho·rā·ṯōw wə·nir·’āh šê·nîṯ ’el- hak·kō·hên
verses.literal: But if the rash spreads further . . . on his skin after he has shown himself to the priest for his cleansing he must present himself again to the priest
verses.literalPt: Mas, se a pústula se estender muito na pele, depois de se ter mostrado ao sacerdote para a sua purificação, de novo se lhe mostrará.

verses.original: וְרָאָה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהִנֵּ֛ה פָּשְׂתָ֥ה הַמִּסְפַּ֖חַת בָּע֑וֹר וְטִמְּא֥וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן צָרַ֥עַת הִֽוא׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·’āh hak·kō·hên wə·hin·nêh pā·śə·ṯāh ham·mis·pa·ḥaṯ bā·‘ō·wr wə·ṭim·mə·’ōw hak·kō·hên ṣā·ra·‘aṯ hî
verses.literal: The priest will reexamine him and if the rash has spread on the skin the priest must pronounce him unclean it is a skin disease
verses.literalPt: O sacerdote o examinará, e se a pústula se tiver estendido na pele, declará-lo-á imundo: é lepra.

verses.original: נֶ֣גַע צָרַ֔עַת כִּ֥י תִהְיֶ֖ה בְּאָדָ֑ם וְהוּבָ֖א אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ne·ḡa‘ ṣā·ra·‘aṯ kî ṯih·yeh bə·’ā·ḏām wə·hū·ḇā ’el- hak·kō·hên
verses.literal: When anyone develops a skin disease he must be brought to the priest
verses.literalPt: Quando no homem estiver a praga da lepra, será levado ao sacerdote.

verses.original: וְרָאָ֣ה הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְהִנֵּ֤ה שְׂאֵת־ לְבָנָה֙ בָּע֔וֹר וְהִ֕יא הָפְכָ֖ה שֵׂעָ֣ר לָבָ֑ן וּמִֽחְיַ֛ת בָּשָׂ֥ר חַ֖י בַּשְׂאֵֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·’āh hak·kō·hên wə·hin·nêh śə·’êṯ- lə·ḇā·nāh bā·‘ō·wr wə·hî hā·p̄ə·ḵāh śê·‘ār lā·ḇān ū·miḥ·yaṯ bā·śār ḥay baś·’êṯ
verses.literal: The priest will examine him and if there is a white swelling on the skin that has turned the hair white . . . and there is raw flesh in the swelling
verses.literalPt: O sacerdote o examinará; se houver inchação branca na pele, a qual tornou branco o pelo, e aparecer na inchação carne viva,

verses.original: צָרַ֨עַת נוֹשֶׁ֤נֶת הִוא֙ בְּע֣וֹר בְּשָׂר֔וֹ וְטִמְּא֖וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֑ן לֹ֣א יַסְגִּרֶ֔נּוּ כִּ֥י טָמֵ֖א הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: ṣā·ra·‘aṯ nō·wō·še·neṯ hî bə·‘ō·wr bə·śā·rōw wə·ṭim·mə·’ōw hak·kō·hên lō yas·gi·ren·nū kî ṭā·mê hū
verses.literal: it is a chronic skin disease . . . . . . and the priest must pronounce him unclean He need not isolate him for he is unclean
verses.literalPt: é lepra inveterada na pele da carne. O sacerdote o declarará imundo; não o encerrará, porque é imundo.

verses.original: וְאִם־ פָּר֨וֹחַ תִּפְרַ֤ח הַצָּרַ֙עַת֙ בָּע֔וֹר וְכִסְּתָ֣ה הַצָּרַ֗עַת אֵ֚ת כָּל־ ע֣וֹר הַנֶּ֔גַע מֵרֹאשׁ֖וֹ וְעַד־ רַגְלָ֑יו לְכָל־ מַרְאֵ֖ה עֵינֵ֥י הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- pā·rō·w·aḥ tip̄·raḥ haṣ·ṣā·ra·‘aṯ bā·‘ō·wr wə·ḵis·sə·ṯāh haṣ·ṣā·ra·‘aṯ ’êṯ kāl- ‘ō·wr han·ne·ḡa‘ mê·rō·šōw wə·‘aḏ- raḡ·lāw lə·ḵāl mar·’êh ‘ê·nê hak·kō·hên
verses.literal: But if the skin disease breaks out . . . all over his skin so that it covers all the skin of the infected person from head to foot . . . as far as the priest can see . . .
verses.literalPt: Se a lepra se espalhar pela pele e cobrir desde a cabeça até os pés toda a pele daquele que tem a praga, quanto podem ver os olhos do sacerdote,

verses.original: וְרָאָ֣ה הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְהִנֵּ֨ה כִסְּתָ֤ה הַצָּרַ֙עַת֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ בְּשָׂר֔וֹ וְטִהַ֖ר אֶת־ הַנָּ֑גַע כֻּלּ֛וֹ הָפַ֥ךְ לָבָ֖ן טָה֥וֹר הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·’āh hak·kō·hên wə·hin·nêh ḵis·sə·ṯāh haṣ·ṣā·ra·‘aṯ ’eṯ- kāl- bə·śā·rōw wə·ṭi·har ’eṯ- han·nā·ḡa‘ kul·lōw hā·p̄aḵ lā·ḇān ṭā·hō·wr hū
verses.literal: the priest shall examine him and if the disease has covered his entire body he is to pronounce the infected person clean Since it has all turned . . . white he is clean
verses.literalPt: este o examinará. Se a lepra tiver coberto a carne toda, declarará limpo o que tem a praga: a lepra tornou-se branca; o homem é limpo.

verses.original: וּבְי֨וֹם הֵרָא֥וֹת בּ֛וֹ בָּשָׂ֥ר חַ֖י יִטְמָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·yō·wm hê·rā·’ō·wṯ bōw bā·śār ḥay yiṭ·mā
verses.literal: But whenever raw flesh appears on someone he will be unclean
verses.literalPt: Mas, quando nele aparecer a carne viva, será imundo.

verses.original: וְרָאָ֧ה הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת־ הַבָּשָׂ֥ר הַחַ֖י וְטִמְּא֑וֹ הַבָּשָׂ֥ר הַחַ֛י טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא צָרַ֥עַת הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·’āh hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- hab·bā·śār ha·ḥay wə·ṭim·mə·’ōw hab·bā·śār ha·ḥay ṭā·mê hū ṣā·ra·‘aṯ hū
verses.literal: When the priest sees the raw flesh he must pronounce him unclean The raw flesh is unclean it is a skin disease . . .
verses.literalPt: O sacerdote examinará a carne viva e declarará o homem imundo; a carne viva é imunda; é lepra.

verses.original: א֣וֹ כִ֥י יָשׁ֛וּב הַבָּשָׂ֥ר הַחַ֖י וְנֶהְפַּ֣ךְ לְלָבָ֑ן וּבָ֖א אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw ḵî yā·šūḇ hab·bā·śār ha·ḥay wə·neh·paḵ lə·lā·ḇān ū·ḇā ’el- hak·kō·hên
verses.literal: But if the raw flesh changes and turns white he must go to the priest
verses.literalPt: Se a carne viva mudar e ficar de novo branca, o homem virá ao sacerdote,

verses.original: וְרָאָ֙הוּ֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהִנֵּ֛ה נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ הַנֶּ֖גַע לְלָבָ֑ן וְטִהַ֧ר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת־ הַנֶּ֖גַע טָה֥וֹר הֽוּא׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·’ā·hū hak·kō·hên wə·hin·nêh neh·paḵ han·ne·ḡa‘ lə·lā·ḇān wə·ṭi·har hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- han·ne·ḡa‘ ṭā·hō·wr hū
verses.literal: The priest will reexamine him and if the infection has turned white the priest is to pronounce the infected person clean then he is clean
verses.literalPt: e este o examinará. Se a lepra se tiver tornado branca, o sacerdote declarará limpo o que tem a praga: está limpo.

verses.original: וּבָשָׂ֕ר כִּֽי־ יִהְיֶ֥ה בֽוֹ־ בְעֹר֖וֹ שְׁחִ֑ין וְנִרְפָּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·śār kî- yih·yeh ḇōw- ḇə·‘ō·rōw šə·ḥîn wə·nir·pā
verses.literal: When a boil appears on someone’s skin . . . and it heals
verses.literalPt: Quando sarar a carne em cuja pele houver uma úlcera,

verses.original: וְהָיָ֞ה בִּמְק֤וֹם הַשְּׁחִין֙ שְׂאֵ֣ת לְבָנָ֔ה א֥וֹ בַהֶ֖רֶת לְבָנָ֣ה אֲדַמְדָּ֑מֶת וְנִרְאָ֖ה אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bim·qō·wm haš·šə·ḥîn śə·’êṯ lə·ḇā·nāh ’ōw ḇa·he·reṯ lə·ḇā·nāh ’ă·ḏam·dā·meṯ wə·nir·’āh ’el- hak·kō·hên
verses.literal: and a white swelling or a reddish-white . . . spot develops where the boil was he must present himself to the priest
verses.literalPt: e no lugar da úlcera aparecer uma inchação branca, ou uma mancha lustrosa, branca tirando a vermelho, mostrar-se-á ao sacerdote;

verses.original: וְרָאָ֣ה הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְהִנֵּ֤ה מַרְאֶ֙הָ֙ שָׁפָ֣ל מִן־ הָע֔וֹר וּשְׂעָרָ֖הּ הָפַ֣ךְ לָבָ֑ן וְטִמְּא֧וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֛ן נֶֽגַע־ צָרַ֥עַת הִ֖וא בַּשְּׁחִ֥ין פָּרָֽחָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·’āh hak·kō·hên wə·hin·nêh mar·’e·hā šā·p̄āl min- hā·‘ō·wr ū·śə·‘ā·rāh hā·p̄aḵ lā·ḇān wə·ṭim·mə·’ōw hak·kō·hên ne·ḡa‘- ṣā·ra·‘aṯ hî baš·šə·ḥîn pā·rā·ḥāh
verses.literal: The priest shall examine it and if it appears to be beneath . . . the skin and the hair in it has turned white the priest . . . shall pronounce him unclean it is a diseased infection that has broken out in the boil
verses.literalPt: e o sacerdote a examinará. Se ela parecer mais funda que a pele, e o pelo se tiver tornado branco, o sacerdote declarará o homem imundo: é a praga da lepra, que brotou na úlcera.

verses.original: וְאִ֣ם׀ יִרְאֶ֣נָּה הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְהִנֵּ֤ה אֵֽין־ בָּהּ֙ שֵׂעָ֣ר לָבָ֔ן וּשְׁפָלָ֥ה אֵינֶ֛נָּה מִן־ הָע֖וֹר וְהִ֣יא כֵהָ֑ה וְהִסְגִּיר֥וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃

verses.literal: But when the priest examines it if there is no white hair in it and it is not . . . beneath the skin . . . and has faded the priest shall isolate him for seven days

verses.original: א֣וֹ בָשָׂ֔ר כִּֽי־ יִהְיֶ֥ה בְעֹר֖וֹ מִכְוַת־ אֵ֑שׁ וְֽהָיְתָ֞ה מִֽחְיַ֣ת הַמִּכְוָ֗ה בַּהֶ֛רֶת לְבָנָ֥ה אֲדַמְדֶּ֖מֶת א֥וֹ לְבָנָֽה׃

verses.original: וְאִ֣ם׀ יִרְאֶ֣נָּה הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְהִנֵּ֤ה אֵֽין־ בַּבֶּהֶ֙רֶת֙ שֵׂעָ֣ר לָבָ֔ן וּשְׁפָלָ֥ה אֵינֶ֛נָּה מִן־ הָע֖וֹר וְהִ֣וא כֵהָ֑ה וְהִסְגִּיר֥וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃

verses.literal: Or if . . . his hairline . . . recedes and he is bald on his forehead he is still clean
verses.literalPt: Se os cabelos lhe caírem da parte dianteira da cabeça, ele é meio calvo; contudo, é limpo.

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ יִהְיֶ֤ה בַקָּרַ֙חַת֙ א֣וֹ בַגַּבַּ֔חַת נֶ֖גַע לָבָ֣ן אֲדַמְדָּ֑ם צָרַ֤עַת פֹּרַ֙חַת֙ הִ֔וא בְּקָרַחְתּ֖וֹ א֥וֹ בְגַבַּחְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- yih·yeh ḇaq·qā·ra·ḥaṯ ’ōw ḇag·gab·ba·ḥaṯ ne·ḡa‘ lā·ḇān ’ă·ḏam·dām ṣā·ra·‘aṯ pō·ra·ḥaṯ hî bə·qā·raḥ·tōw ’ōw ḇə·ḡab·baḥ·tōw
verses.literal: But if there is a reddish-white . . . sore on the bald head or forehead it is an infectious disease breaking out on it . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Mas, se na calva, ou na meia calva, houver uma praga branca tirando a vermelho, é a lepra que lhe está brotando na calva ou na meia calva.

verses.original: וְרָאָ֨ה אֹת֜וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְהִנֵּ֤ה שְׂאֵת־ הַנֶּ֙גַע֙ לְבָנָ֣ה אֲדַמְדֶּ֔מֶת בְּקָרַחְתּ֖וֹ א֣וֹ בְגַבַּחְתּ֑וֹ כְּמַרְאֵ֥ה צָרַ֖עַת ע֥וֹר בָּשָֽׂר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·’āh ’ō·ṯōw hak·kō·hên wə·hin·nêh śə·’êṯ- han·ne·ḡa‘ lə·ḇā·nāh ’ă·ḏam·de·meṯ bə·qā·raḥ·tōw ’ōw ḇə·ḡab·baḥ·tōw kə·mar·’êh ṣā·ra·‘aṯ ‘ō·wr bā·śār
verses.literal: The priest is to examine him and if the swelling of the infection on his bald head or forehead is reddish-white . . . like a skin disease
verses.literalPt: O sacerdote examinará o homem. Se na calva ou na meia calva a inchação da praga for branca tirando a vermelho, como parece a lepra na pele da carne,

verses.original: אִישׁ־ צָר֥וּעַ ה֖וּא טָמֵ֣א ה֑וּא טַמֵּ֧א יְטַמְּאֶ֛נּוּ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן בְּרֹאשׁ֥וֹ נִגְעֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš- ṣā·rū·a‘ hū ṭā·mê hū ṭam·mê yə·ṭam·mə·’en·nū hak·kō·hên bə·rō·šōw niḡ·‘ōw
verses.literal: the man is diseased he is unclean . . . The priest must pronounce him unclean . . . because of the infection on his head
verses.literalPt: o homem é leproso, é imundo. O sacerdote certamente o declarará imundo: a sua praga está na cabeça.

verses.original: וְהַצָּר֜וּעַ אֲשֶׁר־ בּ֣וֹ הַנֶּ֗גַע בְּגָדָ֞יו יִהְי֤וּ פְרֻמִים֙ וְרֹאשׁוֹ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה פָר֔וּעַ וְעַל־ שָׂפָ֖ם יַעְטֶ֑ה וְטָמֵ֥א׀ טָמֵ֖א יִקְרָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·haṣ·ṣā·rū·a‘ ’ă·šer- bōw han·ne·ḡa‘ bə·ḡā·ḏāw yih·yū p̄ə·ru·mîm wə·rō·šōw yih·yeh p̄ā·rū·a‘ wə·‘al- śā·p̄ām ya‘·ṭeh wə·ṭā·mê ṭā·mê yiq·rā
verses.literal: A diseased person . . . - must wear torn clothes . . . . . . and let his hair . . . hang loose . . . and he must cover his mouth and cry out Unclean unclean
verses.literalPt: Os vestidos do leproso, em quem está a praga, serão rasgados, e a cabeça será descoberta, cobrirá o bigode e clamará: Imundo! Imundo!

verses.original: כָּל־ יְמֵ֞י אֲשֶׁ֨ר הַנֶּ֥גַע בּ֛וֹ יִטְמָ֖א טָמֵ֣א ה֑וּא בָּדָ֣ד יֵשֵׁ֔ב מִח֥וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה מוֹשָׁבֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kāl- yə·mê ’ă·šer han·ne·ḡa‘ bōw yiṭ·mā ṭā·mê hū bā·ḏāḏ yê·šêḇ mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh mō·wō·šā·ḇōw
verses.literal: As long as he has the infection he remains . . . . . . . . . unclean He must live alone in a place outside the camp
verses.literalPt: Será imundo por todos os dias em que a praga estiver nele. É imundo, habitará só: a sua habitação será fora do arraial.

verses.original: וְהַבֶּ֕גֶד כִּֽי־ יִהְיֶ֥ה ב֖וֹ נֶ֣גַע צָרָ֑עַת בְּבֶ֣גֶד צֶ֔מֶר א֖וֹ בְּבֶ֥גֶד פִּשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hab·be·ḡeḏ kî- yih·yeh ḇōw ne·ḡa‘ ṣā·rā·‘aṯ bə·ḇe·ḡeḏ ṣe·mer ’ōw bə·ḇe·ḡeḏ piš·tîm
verses.literal: If any fabric is contaminated with mildew any wool or . . . linen garment
verses.literalPt: O vestido também, em que há a praga da lepra, seja vestido de lã, seja vestido de linho;

verses.original: א֤וֹ בִֽשְׁתִי֙ א֣וֹ בְעֵ֔רֶב לַפִּשְׁתִּ֖ים וְלַצָּ֑מֶר א֣וֹ בְע֔וֹר א֖וֹ בְּכָל־ מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw ḇiš·ṯî ’ōw ḇə·‘ê·reḇ lap·piš·tîm wə·laṣ·ṣā·mer ’ōw ḇə·‘ō·wr ’ōw bə·ḵāl mə·le·ḵeṯ ‘ō·wr
verses.literal: any weave or knit of linen or wool or any article of leather . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: seja na urdidura, seja na trama; de linho, ou de lã; seja numa pele, ou em qualquer coisa feita de pele;

verses.original: וְהָיָ֨ה הַנֶּ֜גַע יְרַקְרַ֣ק׀ א֣וֹ אֲדַמְדָּ֗ם בַּבֶּגֶד֩ א֨וֹ בָע֜וֹר אֽוֹ־ בַשְּׁתִ֤י אוֹ־ בָעֵ֙רֶב֙ א֣וֹ בְכָל־ כְּלִי־ ע֔וֹר נֶ֥גַע צָרַ֖עַת ה֑וּא וְהָרְאָ֖ה אֶת־ הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh han·ne·ḡa‘ yə·raq·raq ’ōw ’ă·ḏam·dām bab·be·ḡeḏ ’ōw ḇā·‘ō·wr ’ōw- ḇaš·šə·ṯî ’ōw- ḇā·‘ê·reḇ ’ōw ḇə·ḵāl- kə·lî- ‘ō·wr ne·ḡa‘ ṣā·ra·‘aṯ hū wə·hā·rə·’āh ’eṯ- hak·kō·hên
verses.literal: and if the mark in the fabric leather weave knit or leather article is green or red then it is contaminated with mildew and must be shown to the priest
verses.literalPt: se a praga for verde ou vermelha no vestido, ou na pele, ou na urdidura, ou na trama, em qualquer coisa feita de pele, é a praga da lepra, e mostrar-se-á ao sacerdote.

verses.original: וְרָאָ֥ה הַכֹּהֵ֖ן אֶת־ הַנָּ֑גַע וְהִסְגִּ֥יר אֶת־ הַנֶּ֖גַע שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·’āh hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- han·nā·ḡa‘ wə·his·gîr ’eṯ- han·ne·ḡa‘ šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm
verses.literal: And the priest is to examine the mildew and isolate the contaminated fabric for seven days
verses.literalPt: O sacerdote examinará a praga e encerrará por sete dias aquilo que tem a praga.

verses.original: וְרָאָ֨ה אֶת־ הַנֶּ֜גַע בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י כִּֽי־ פָשָׂ֤ה הַנֶּ֙גַע֙ בַּ֠בֶּגֶד אֽוֹ־ בַשְּׁתִ֤י אֽוֹ־ בָעֵ֙רֶב֙ א֣וֹ בָע֔וֹר לְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ יֵעָשֶׂ֥ה הָע֖וֹר לִמְלָאכָ֑ה צָרַ֧עַת מַמְאֶ֛רֶת הַנֶּ֖גַע טָמֵ֥א הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·’āh ’eṯ- han·ne·ḡa‘ bay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î kî- p̄ā·śāh han·ne·ḡa‘ bab·be·ḡeḏ ’ōw- ḇaš·šə·ṯî ’ōw- ḇā·‘ê·reḇ ’ōw ḇā·‘ō·wr lə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- yê·‘ā·śeh hā·‘ō·wr lim·lā·ḵāh ṣā·ra·‘aṯ mam·’e·reṯ han·ne·ḡa‘ ṭā·mê hū
verses.literal: On the seventh day the priest shall reexamine it and if the mildew has spread in the fabric weave . . . knit . . . or leather then regardless of how it is used . . . it is a harmful mildew the article is unclean
verses.literalPt: Ao sétimo dia, examinará a praga. Se a praga se tiver espalhado no vestido, seja na urdidura, seja na trama, ou na pele, seja qual for a obra em que se empregue, a praga é uma lepra roedora; é imunda.

verses.original: וְשָׂרַ֨ף אֶת־ הַבֶּ֜גֶד א֥וֹ אֶֽת־ הַשְּׁתִ֣י׀ א֣וֹ אֶת־ הָעֵ֗רֶב בַּצֶּ֙מֶר֙ א֣וֹ בַפִּשְׁתִּ֔ים א֚וֹ אֶת־ כָּל־ כְּלִ֣י הָע֔וֹר אֲשֶׁר־ יִהְיֶ֥ה ב֖וֹ הַנָּ֑גַע כִּֽי־ צָרַ֤עַת מַמְאֶ֙רֶת֙ הִ֔וא בָּאֵ֖שׁ תִּשָּׂרֵֽף׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śā·rap̄ ’eṯ- hab·be·ḡeḏ ’ōw ’eṯ- haš·šə·ṯî ’ōw ’eṯ- hā·‘ê·reḇ baṣ·ṣe·mer ’ōw ḇap·piš·tîm ’ōw ’eṯ- kāl- kə·lî hā·‘ō·wr ’ă·šer- yih·yeh ḇōw han·nā·ḡa‘ kî- ṣā·ra·‘aṯ mam·’e·reṯ hî bā·’êš tiś·śā·rêp̄
verses.literal: He is to burn the fabric weave or knit whether the contaminated item is wool or linen . . . or leather Since the mildew is harmful the article must be burned up . . .
verses.literalPt: Queimará o vestido, seja a urdidura, seja a trama, de lã ou de linho, ou qualquer coisa feita de pele, em que se acha a praga, pois é uma lepra roedora; no fogo queimar-se-á.

verses.original: וְאִם֮ יִרְאֶ֣ה הַכֹּהֵן֒ וְהִנֵּה֙ לֹא־ פָשָׂ֣ה הַנֶּ֔גַע בַּבֶּ֕גֶד א֥וֹ בַשְּׁתִ֖י א֣וֹ בָעֵ֑רֶב א֖וֹ בְּכָל־ כְּלִי־ עֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im yir·’eh hak·kō·hên wə·hin·nêh lō- p̄ā·śāh han·ne·ḡa‘ bab·be·ḡeḏ ’ōw ḇaš·šə·ṯî ’ōw ḇā·‘ê·reḇ ’ōw bə·ḵāl kə·lî- ‘ō·wr
verses.literal: But when the priest reexamines it if the mildew has not spread in the fabric weave knit . . . or leather article
verses.literalPt: Se o sacerdote os examinar, e a praga não se tiver espalhado no vestido, nem na urdidura, nem na trama, nem em qualquer coisa feita de pele,

verses.original: וְצִוָּה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְכִ֨בְּס֔וּ אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ בּ֖וֹ הַנָּ֑גַע וְהִסְגִּיר֥וֹ שִׁבְעַת־ יָמִ֖ים שֵׁנִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣiw·wāh hak·kō·hên wə·ḵib·bə·sū ’êṯ ’ă·šer- bōw han·nā·ḡa‘ wə·his·gî·rōw šiḇ·‘aṯ- yā·mîm šê·nîṯ
verses.literal: the priest is to order the contaminated article to be washed and isolated for another seven days
verses.literalPt: o sacerdote ordenará que se lave aquilo em que está a lepra e encerrá-lo-á por mais sete dias.

verses.original: וְרָאָ֨ה הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אַחֲרֵ֣י׀ הֻכַּבֵּ֣ס אֶת־ הַנֶּ֗גַע וְ֠הִנֵּה לֹֽא־ הָפַ֨ךְ הַנֶּ֤גַע אֶת־ עֵינוֹ֙ וְהַנֶּ֣גַע לֹֽא־ פָשָׂ֔ה טָמֵ֣א ה֔וּא בָּאֵ֖שׁ תִּשְׂרְפֶ֑נּוּ פְּחֶ֣תֶת הִ֔וא בְּקָרַחְתּ֖וֹ א֥וֹ בְגַבַּחְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·’āh hak·kō·hên ’a·ḥă·rê huk·kab·bês ’eṯ- han·ne·ḡa‘ wə·hin·nêh lō- hā·p̄aḵ han·ne·ḡa‘ ’eṯ- ‘ê·nōw wə·han·ne·ḡa‘ lō- p̄ā·śāh ṭā·mê hū bā·’êš tiś·rə·p̄en·nū pə·ḥe·ṯeṯ hî bə·qā·raḥ·tōw ’ōw ḇə·ḡab·baḥ·tōw
verses.literal: After it has been washed the priest is to reexamine it and if the mildewed article has not changed in appearance it is unclean Even though the mildew has not spread you must burn it . . . whether the rot is on the front or back
verses.literalPt: O sacerdote a examinará depois que for lavada. Se a praga não tiver mudado de cor, nem se tiver espalhado, é imunda. Queimá-la-ás no fogo: é uma lepra roedora quer por dentro quer por fora.

verses.original: וְאִם֮ רָאָ֣ה הַכֹּהֵן֒ וְהִנֵּה֙ כֵּהָ֣ה הַנֶּ֔גַע אַחֲרֵ֖י הֻכַּבֵּ֣ס אֹת֑וֹ וְקָרַ֣ע אֹת֗וֹ מִן־ הַבֶּ֙גֶד֙ א֣וֹ מִן־ הָע֔וֹר א֥וֹ מִן־ הַשְּׁתִ֖י א֥וֹ מִן־ הָעֵֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im rā·’āh hak·kō·hên wə·hin·nêh kê·hāh han·ne·ḡa‘ ’a·ḥă·rê huk·kab·bês ’ō·ṯōw wə·qā·ra‘ ’ō·ṯōw min- hab·be·ḡeḏ ’ōw min- hā·‘ō·wr ’ōw min- haš·šə·ṯî ’ōw min- hā·‘ê·reḇ
verses.literal: If the priest . . . examines it and the mildew has faded after it has been washed he must cut the contaminated section out of the fabric leather - weave . . . . . . or . . . knit
verses.literalPt: Se o sacerdote a examinar, e a praga for de uma cor escura, depois que for lavada, rasgá-la-á do vestido, ou da pele, ou da urdidura ou da trama.

verses.original: וְאִם־ תֵּרָאֶ֨ה ע֜וֹד בַּ֠בֶּגֶד אֽוֹ־ בַשְּׁתִ֤י אֽוֹ־ בָעֵ֙רֶב֙ א֣וֹ בְכָל־ כְּלִי־ ע֔וֹר פֹּרַ֖חַת הִ֑וא בָּאֵ֣שׁ תִּשְׂרְפֶ֔נּוּ אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ בּ֖וֹ הַנָּֽגַע׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- tê·rā·’eh ‘ō·wḏ bab·be·ḡeḏ ’ōw- ḇaš·šə·ṯî ’ōw- ḇā·‘ê·reḇ ’ōw ḇə·ḵāl- kə·lî- ‘ō·wr pō·ra·ḥaṯ hî bā·’êš tiś·rə·p̄en·nū ’êṯ ’ă·šer- bōw han·nā·ḡa‘
verses.literal: But if it reappears . . . in the fabric weave or knit . . . or on any leather article it is spreading You must burn . . . the contaminated article
verses.literalPt: Se a praga ainda aparecer no vestido, quer na urdidura quer na trama, ou em qualquer coisa feita de pele, é uma lepra brotante; com fogo queimarás aquilo em que está a praga.

verses.original: וְהַבֶּ֡גֶד אֽוֹ־ הַשְּׁתִ֨י אוֹ־ הָעֵ֜רֶב אֽוֹ־ כָל־ כְּלִ֤י הָעוֹר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תְּכַבֵּ֔ס וְסָ֥ר מֵהֶ֖ם הַנָּ֑גַע וְכֻבַּ֥ס שֵׁנִ֖ית וְטָהֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hab·be·ḡeḏ ’ōw- haš·šə·ṯî ’ōw- hā·‘ê·reḇ ’ōw- ḵāl kə·lî hā·‘ō·wr ’ă·šer tə·ḵab·bês wə·sār mê·hem han·nā·ḡa‘ wə·ḵub·bas šê·nîṯ wə·ṭā·hêr
verses.literal: If the mildew disappears from the fabric weave or knit . . . or any leather article after washing then it is to be washed again and it will be clean
verses.literalPt: O vestido, quer a urdidura, quer a trama, ou qualquer coisa que for feita de pele, que lavares, se a praga tiver desaparecido deles, lavar-se-ão segunda vez, e serão limpos.

verses.original: זֹ֠את תּוֹרַ֨ת נֶֽגַע־ צָרַ֜עַת בֶּ֥גֶד הַצֶּ֣מֶר׀ א֣וֹ הַפִּשְׁתִּ֗ים א֤וֹ הַשְּׁתִי֙ א֣וֹ הָעֵ֔רֶב א֖וֹ כָּל־ כְּלִי־ ע֑וֹר לְטַהֲר֖וֹ א֥וֹ לְטַמְּאֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: zōṯ tō·w·raṯ ne·ḡa‘- ṣā·ra·‘aṯ be·ḡeḏ haṣ·ṣe·mer ’ōw hap·piš·tîm ’ōw haš·šə·ṯî ’ōw hā·‘ê·reḇ ’ōw kāl- kə·lî- ‘ō·wr lə·ṭa·hă·rōw ’ōw lə·ṭam·mə·’ōw
verses.literal: This is the law concerning a mildew contamination in wool or linen fabric weave or knit or any leather article for pronouncing it clean or unclean
verses.literalPt: Esta é a lei da praga da lepra no vestido de lã ou de linho, quer na urdidura, quer na trama, ou em qualquer coisa feita de pele, para os declarar limpos, ou para os declarar imundos.
